en: A black-and-white image of a mid-20th-century cargo or passenger ship named 'FOLIAS', seen in harbor with a cityscape in the background. The ship has classic features like masts and cargo cranes typical of the early to mid-1900s, and the funnel bears a large 'S'. The sky is slightly cloudy and there is no visible movement in the harbor waters. Architecture on the shore suggests a European coastal city.
